root_cause: The existing portal Powerhouse runtime bridge removed a debounced event from the in-memory queue before POST success, suppressed failed sends with catch, trusted any HTTP 2xx without matching the immutable Brain record, and queued work without a strict source-principal binding. Failed/ambiguous action intent or post-sync evidence could silently vanish or risk crossing a later identity switch.
fix: Retain original immutable queued records with captured tenant principal, observedAt, correlation and idempotency key; exact ID/correlation Brain readback is the only dequeue criterion; original 45s/focus/identity refresh opportunistically retries with in-flight suppression; original auth boundary resets prior tenant queue and lineage.
prevention_rules: Never remove portal queued evidence or requested action before exact canonical Brain ACK of matching record ID and correlation ID.
Retry original immutable record on existing session-bound refresh/focus, do not invent duplicate IDs or a new scheduler.
Never carry queued original tenant evidence, idempotency and previous correlation into next identity.
Browser session retry is not a durable restart outbox; keep #4215 EVIDENCE_DUE until authenticated post-restart and end-to-end customer verification.
owner: Original Portal V2 and ONE BRAIN P0 #4215
